C1285.title: Sichuan Loan Fraud Case: Over 12 Billion Yuan Swindled via Provident Fund Top-Ups for 6,000 Individuals
C1285.summary: Authorities in Sichuan dismantled a large-scale loan fraud ring involving over 100 members.
